description: This file defines the RobotSpeakSettings class, which extends PreferenceActivity to implement a settings screen for the application. It primarily loads header preferences from a resource file and contains minimal logic.

classes.name: RobotSpeakSettings
classes.description: An Android PreferenceActivity that loads preference headers from a resource file to display a settings UI.

methods.description: Loads preference headers from a specified resource into the provided list.
